thread_text:
deploy-bot: Canary rollout started for tenant-b v2 -> 3 pods (selector=tenant=tenant-b) at 12:04 UTC
incident-bot: Pager: prod-high-error-rate fired for service=tenant-b-gateway (severity=P2)
jen (oncall): I'm on it, pulling logs. What was the changed manifest?
irfan (eng): We toggled the ff to send traffic to the new deployment + HPA switch to metrics-server -> custom metrics. HPA manifest I pushed had minReplicas: 0 (template derived from infra lib).
sam (sre): Alert shows a sudden drop to 0 replicas for tenant-b-backend-hpa right after rollout. Gateway 503s started ~30s later.
jen (oncall): Can anyone confirm HPA scaled down? kubectl get hpa tenant-b-backend-hpa -o yaml?
matt (platform): Confirmed: currentReplicas: 0, desiredReplicas: 0, minReplicas: 0. Metric endpoints returning 404 because service annotation for prometheus scraping is wrong (prometheus.io/scrape: "false").
irfan (eng): Ugh — our deployment template overrides service annotations and flipped scraping off in the templated chart. That made the custom metric disappear so HPA had no data and evaluated to 0.
sam (sre): Customer impact: multiple tenants reporting 502/503 on writes. Traffic dropped to old route for ~10% requests but most failing. Support queue has ~12 tickets opened in last 8m.
support-bot: Support alert: # of affected sessions ~1.2k, top errors: 503 Service Unavailable, gateway timed out.
jen (oncall): Immediate mitigation: revert feature flag or emergency rollback. Which is faster?
irfan (eng): Flip ff off will route traffic back to previous deployment immediately. Rolling back deploy would also work but traffic switch is faster.
matt (platform): Also we can patch HPA minReplicas to 2 as a short-term fix but ff flip is safest to stop blowup.
jen (oncall): Doing the ff kill-switch now. @irfan can you stand by to monitor?
irfan (eng): On it. Flipped ff tenant-b.use_v2 -> false :thumbsup:
incident-bot: Feature flag toggle recorded by deploy-ui (actor=jen).
sam (sre): I'm seeing traffic normalizing, error rate dropping from 240rps to 18rps across the fleet. Response latency for gateway is back to baseline.
jen (oncall): Great. Still going to patch HPA to avoid recurrence. matt, can you apply minReplicas=2 to tenant-b-backend-hpa?
matt (platform): Patching now:
```
kubectl patch hpa tenant-b-backend-hpa -n prod --type='merge' -p '{"spec":{"minReplicas":2}}'
```

matt (platform): Patch applied, verifying pod count... pods are spinning up.
jen (oncall): Rollback plan for the rollout: revert chart change that disabled prometheus scrape annotation, and run a canary with explicit minReplicas=2.
irfan (eng): Will open a PR to revert the template override and add a test to ensure service annotations preserved.
sam (sre): Postmortem checklist: timeline, root cause (template override + minReplicas 0), mitigation (ff kill-switch + hpa patch), follow-ups (add helm template unit test, add HPA validation CI).
jen (oncall): Notifying on-call lead and customers impacted: scheduled a short customer note. Any objections to closing pager once metrics stable for 15m?
sam (sre): No objections. Continue monitoring 30m.
incident-bot: Pager closed by jen (oncall) at 12:22 UTC.
jen (oncall): Filing incident ticket with steps and linking PR. Thanks everyone for quick response. :heart:
